source.html:
Gluten-free Graham Crackers
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Side
Ingredients
  • 2¾ c Gluten-free flour
  • 1 c Almond flour
  • 1 c brown sugar, packed
  • 1½ tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • ½ tsp cinnamon
  • ¾ c butter, cut into cubes
  • ⅓ c molasses
  • ½ c milk
  • 1 tsp vanilla
Instructions
  1. Place both flours, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon into a large bowl. Wisk to combine.
  2. Add butter and with a pastry cutter, cut butter into flour mixture until the mixture resembles cornmeal.
  3. Add the molasses, milk, and vanilla and mix until the dough forms a ball.
  4. Divide into two balls. Press each ball into a ½-inch thick disk, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
  5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
  6. Unwrap the chilled dough and place it onto a large piece of parchment paper and top with a second sheet of parchment paper. Roll the dough out until it is ⅛-inch thick. Slide the rolled dough and parchment paper onto a half sheet pan. Remove the top sheet of parchment paper and cut the dough, using a rolling pizza cutter, into 2-inch square pieces. Using a fork, poke holes all over the top of the dough. Repeat with other dough ball.
  7. Leave the crackers on the pan and bake on the middle racks of the oven for 25 minutes, rotating the pans halfway through cooking. Allow to cool completely. Break into individual pieces and store in airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
